description: A chunky low-poly four-by-four light military utility vehicle parked on the ground, no crew, seen from the front-left. A wide low boxy angular body with a flat bonnet, a flat vertical grille with a wide slatted front, square flat headlights at the corners, a short upright windscreen of two flat panes, four doors with small square flat windows and a flat hard roof; a round ring mount on the middle of the roof carrying a heavy machine gun on a short post with a small flat gun shield in front of it, the gun pointing forward. Four large chunky wheels of the same size on two axles under wide flared wheel arches. Body, doors, roof and wheel arches painted one desert tan; grille slats, bumper, gun, gun mount and gun shield dark gunmetal grey; windows a single flat dark blue-grey; tyres dark charcoal, hubs dark tan; headlights pale grey. The spare wheel on the rear face faces away and is hidden; the right-hand wheels are hidden behind the body.
